messages.content: Review this bounded research iteration skeptically. Return JSON with verdict, fatal_issues, permitted_test, forbidden_claims, next_design_requirement. Not a peer-review or novelty certification. Story: acquired experience should earn workflow roles only within empirically supported handoff conditions. Candidate R1: fit finite set-operation version space (source/predicate/union/intersection/two differences) to actual public training data and executed target set; new role output adopted only if types/scope covered and all surviving programs agree. Native source has sizes22,16,11 and unique surviving intersection. This therefore may collapse exactly to ordinary programmatic skill reuse (ASI arXiv2504.06821 section2.3) rather than any new qualification algorithm. AWM ICML2025 already induces text workflows; ReasoningBank ICLR2026 learns from successful and failed trajectories. Proposed test: all3 previously observed AppWorld download variants, not a cherry-picked positive subset; fresh-world original saved-code replay versus replacement of only selected-set handoff from source-derived intersection, versus identical-source single-program control. Preserve consumer suffix. Use recorded public API state, no ground-truth in execution. Researcher supplies public task-to-native-library adapter equally.9 CPU native replay worlds, no new task-solving LLM calls. Validate original false/true/false terminal results replicate; stop on mismatch/infrastructure failure. Score official evaluator after execution only. This is posthoc causal debugging of fixed traces, NOT autonomous repair, generalization performance, multiagent superiority or full-method validation. If singleton control matches exactly, reject added-version-space novelty while retaining any source-scope diagnostic. Is this specific test interpretable, what must be repaired before launch, and what can follow without inventing novelty?
